userDirection: Preserve instance and subscription; research isolation of historical planning record.

proposedSealedRegistry.recordPreservation: Retain the original row/environment_id/plan bytes/hash plus complete independently pinned preimage.
proposedSealedRegistry.registration: One fresh approved record snapshot; require no jobs, resources, reservations, schedules or steps and no execution attempts.
proposedSealedRegistry.permanentSealing: Prevent original row update/delete and every new execution reference, including jobs, created/owned resources, capacity, schedules and steps.
proposedSealedRegistry.businessContinuity: Do not freeze or change the customer instance/subscription; future live deployment must use a new deployment record and remain visible to all ownership fences.
proposedSealedRegistry.snapshotProtocol: Separate versioned certificate-bearing protocol, only exact sealed records can be classified non-owning; never a generic mode=plan_only or cell_key filter.
proposedSealedRegistry.legacyProtocol: Existing schema2 adapter must continue to fail closed until the new migration and protocol are independently approved and proved.

newScopeRequiredBeforeImplementationActi: New append-only registration schema and permanent reference-sealing protections; not a replacement of immutable environment trigger.
Versioned ownership snapshot/admission/authority/deletion proof integration and regression against future new tenant deployments.
Fresh independent registration approval and readback for the exact record; no dynamic SHA self-authorization.
